Name: VisAttrs
Description: Creates visibility attributes (Off/On enum) on a target control and connects them to the visibility of specified nodes.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Creates visibility enum attributes (Off/On) on a target control and connects them to the visibility of specified nodes.

How To Use:
  1. Create the block.
  2. Select the control that will hold the visibility attributes, and click 'Add Selected' or type its name in SetTargetCtrl.
  3. In VisAttrsList, specify the attribute name and the driven nodes in the format:
     AttrName = Node1, Node2
     Example:
     Hair = L_Hair_Geo, R_Hair_Geo
     Jacket = Jacket_Geo
  4. When you click Build, the attributes will be added to the target control and connected to the nodes' visibility.

Fields:
- SetTargetCtrl: The control that will hold the visibility attributes.
- VisAttrsList: List of entries in the format: AttrName = Node1, Node2
- DefaultOn: If True, attributes will default to On. If False, they will default to Off.
